assumption_record.name: Renn Herbal Gathering Rate
assumption_record.statement: For the clarification question 'How many herbs should Renn gather per phase?', the player answered 'You decide'. Applying a conservative provisional rate: when Renn spends a phase solely gathering medicinal herbs in the north grove under ordinary conditions, Renn collects 1 unit of common medicinal herbs. A unit is enough for one simple remedy or small bundle, not a rare or especially potent specimen.
assumption_record.procedure: During the current session, if Renn is assigned to gather medicinal herbs for a full phase and no major hazard, encounter, severe weather, or tool shortage intervenes, add 1 common medicinal herb unit to temporary inventory. If the phase is partly spent traveling, fighting, or otherwise occupied, the Lead Resolver should reduce the yield to 0 unless the action was still primarily gathering. Do not apply this to rare herbs or special reagents without a separate ruling.
basis: Player explicitly delegated the unresolved choice with 'You decide' for the exact question 'How many herbs should Renn gather per phase?'
Rules specialist found no explicit herb-gathering rate and recommended determining quantity from rules or authorized assumption.
Character specialist confirmed Renn can perform the assigned gathering task.
No established table rule, tool bonus, terrain modifier, or rarity rule was supplied.
limitations: This is a bounded temporary rate, not permanent canon.
It does not define herb quality, rarity, market value, or medicinal potency.
It assumes ordinary north grove conditions and no specialized gathering tools or skills.
A different rate may be appropriate if later rules establish herbalism, survival, or profession mechanics.
assumption_record.review_trigger: Permanent revision is justified if established gathering/herbalism rules are introduced, if Renn gains or loses relevant tools or skills, if north grove conditions materially change, or if this rate causes inventory or balance problems.

Applying a conservative provisional rate: when Renn spends a phase solely gathering medicinal herbs in the north grove under ordinary conditions, Renn collects 1 unit of common medicinal herbs. A unit is enough for one simple remedy or small bundle, not a rare or especially potent specimen.
assumption_record.procedure: During the current session, if Renn is assigned to gather medicinal herbs for a full phase and no major hazard, encounter, severe weather, or tool shortage intervenes, add 1 common medicinal herb unit to temporary inventory. If the phase is partly spent traveling, fighting, or otherwise occupied, the Lead Resolver should reduce the yield to 0 unless the action was still primarily gathering. Do not apply this to rare herbs or special reagents without a separate ruling.
basis: Player explicitly delegated the unresolved choice with 'You decide' for the exact question 'How many herbs should Renn gather per phase?'
Rules specialist found no explicit herb-gathering rate and recommended determining quantity from rules or authorized assumption.
Character specialist confirmed Renn can perform the assigned gathering task.
No established table rule, tool bonus, terrain modifier, or rarity rule was supplied.
limitations: This is a bounded temporary rate, not permanent canon.
It does not define herb quality, rarity, market value, or medicinal potency.
It assumes ordinary north grove conditions and no specialized gathering tools or skills.
A different rate may be appropriate if later rules establish herbalism, survival, or profession mechanics.
assumption_record.review_trigger: Permanent revision is justified if established gathering/herbalism rules are introduced, if Renn gains or loses relevant tools or skills, if north grove conditions materially change, or if this rate causes inventory or balance problems.
